questions.text: If, a + b = 18 and a² + b² = 200, then find the value of (a³ + b³).

What is the lateral surface area of a pyramid whose base dimensions are 10 m × 6 m and the slant height is 15 m?

The side length of the larger polygon is 1.5 times that of the smaller one. What is the measure of each interior angle of the larger polygon?
